source.name: Aptean Advanced Bundle for Beverage Manufacturing

mapping.summary: Beverage industry suite for breweries and distilleries: excise tax, deposits, logistics, EMCS.
claims: Calculates and reports excise duty from bonded-location movements or from sales and purchase invoices
Tracks kegs, bottles, crates and pallets as empties
Shows deposit balances per type for customers and vendors
Multi-level charges, promotional items and discounts tied to volume commitments
Quick sales order entry page with item sorting, filtering and order history
Order planning for own fleet or external carrier with weight and pallet constraints
Exchanges e-AD documents with the EU EMCS excise system for goods movements
Event management covering beverage supply, loan material reservation and returns
Contracts with outlets and pubs covering rent, loans and loaned items with fixed or volume-based settlement
Alcohol volume balance reporting per warehouse, including explained losses
Beverage production extensions such as active ingredient handling
Free for 30 days, then a paid subscription
Runs on both Essentials and Premium editions
